notes.title: Last Chance in Xollywood Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35542689/520d6d6ca1c2b068f7471e6f1e9a1b00e7d4d44d.png[/img]

[b]Last Chance in Xollywood[/b], the new game from the creator of Xoo: Xeno Xafari, is now released.

In this sci-fi [b]RPG/visual novel[/b], you are an extraterrestrial movie director at a low-budget movie studio. Struggle against capitalism, corruption, and your eccentric coworkers to get the movie done on time and under budget.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096220/Last_Chance_in_Xollywood

notes.title: Superstorm Melon Date Out Now
notes.content:
Hey people! I made a new game, and it's free!

It's date night in the dystopian future. Hit the town with Mel, a melon-person with psychic powers. Choose where to go, what to do, and what to say in this highly interactive, romance visual novel.

notes.title: Xoo: Xeno Xafari Update: New Area! New Xenos!
notes.content:
[b]Xoo: Xeno Xafari v1.1 is out with cool new stuff![/b]

Xoo Island now has a brand new area. This area opens up sometime randomly after day 50. It features 10 new screens and 30 new xenos to find!

The area is accessible on already existed saved games, but you will have to wait for it to randomly appear which typically takes 5 days if you are past day 50.

Other features of the update include:
[list]
[*] Appearance of journal pages, e-mails, and skill books has been slightly reduced in order to make the game feel less front-loaded.
[*] Shop prices have increased for better pacing of unlockables.
[*] Numerous small tweaks, typos, and bug fixes
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing! [b]If you like this game, do me a monumental favor and leave a positive review.[/b] It would really help me to get better placement on Steam!
